mechanism: The existing AISP_RESEARCH_SUPPLEMENT_V1 container: <exchange>/nfl-labs-supplements/sha256/<64-hex>/{manifest.json,supplement.json} plus the index entry. Content-addressed and byte-verified exactly like the joint-score supplements.

bind_to.authorizationReceiptSha256: the owner's approval receipt, so the permission is traceable to the decision that granted it
bind_to.cohortIdentity: which games this permission covers, and until when
bind_to.originalClocks: source cutoff, forecast cutoff and frozen-at, unchanged from the forecast
bind_to.evidenceClocks: when the evidence was gathered and published

must_not: reuse or rename an existing supplement kind
consumer_status: Implemented and verifying. AISP checks for this record at every NFL final-pregame checkpoint and declines to record a position without it, retaining NO_PAPER_RESEARCH_ELIGIBILITY_RECORD as the reason.

owner_approval.scope: Open the NFL 2026 virtual research experiment and reallocate one daily SportsGameOdds event object from NFL live scores to NFL pregame odds.
owner_approval.real_money: NEVER — virtual research only, no sportsbook execution
